# OSV.dev -- Reference
<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6) -->

## Overview

Open-source vulnerability database and API developed by Google [49]. Launched
2021. Licensed Apache 2.0 [49]. Aggregates data from 24 sources [49].

## How It Differs from NVD/CVE

| Aspect | OSV.dev | NVD/CVE |
|--------|---------|---------|
| Package identification | Package names (direct lockfile mapping) [50] | CPEs (requires mapping) [50] |
| Version specificity | Explicit affected version ranges + Git commits [51] | Often incomplete version info [50] |
| Data maintenance | Automated enrichment + multiple sources [51] | Primarily human analysis [50] |
| Malicious packages | Not tracked | Not tracked [50] |
| Completeness goal | 100% of NVD/CVE since 2016 for OSS [54] | Comprehensive but with gaps [50] |
| Cost | Free, open source [49] | Free, government-funded |
| Update speed | Aggregates from 24 sources including NVD [49] | Single source with human analysis lag [50] |

## Data Sources

Aggregates from 24 sources including [49][52]:
- GitHub Advisory Database
- PyPI Advisory Database
- NVD CVEs (converted for OSS)
- Alpine SecDB
- Debian Security Advisories
- And 19+ other sources

## Ecosystem Coverage

28+ ecosystems including: AlmaLinux, Alpine, Android, crates.io, Debian, Go,
Haskell, Hex, Linux kernel, Maven, npm, NuGet, Packagist, Pub, PyPI, Python,
R, Rocky Linux, RubyGems, Ubuntu OS [52].

## API

Free, no authentication required, no rate limits currently [53].

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/v1/query` | POST | Query single package [53] |
| `/v1/vulns/{id}` | GET | Get specific vulnerability [53] |
| `/v1/querybatch` | POST | Batch query multiple packages [53] |

Response limit: 32MiB on HTTP/1.1, no limit on HTTP/2 [53].

## OSV-Scanner CLI

Official frontend to the OSV database [55]. Written in Go.
Supports: C/C++, Dart, Elixir, Go, Java, JavaScript, PHP, Python, R, Ruby,
Rust [55]. Supports package managers: npm, pip, yarn, maven, go modules,
cargo, gem, composer, nuget [55].

## Auto-Enrichment

OSV.dev automatically expands affected version ranges to explicit lists of
affected versions, removing the need for downstream consumers to calculate
this themselves [51].

## Key Limitation

The 100% NVD/CVE coverage since 2016 is a stated goal, not a verified
achievement [54].

## Used By

- pip-audit (as optional vulnerability service) [31]
- OSV-Scanner (official CLI frontend) [55]
- deps.dev (Google's dependency analysis tool)
